name: Riley Weber
aboutMe: With 8 years' of development experience using primarily C++ and Python, Riley Weber is passionate about delivering robust and performant solutions to complex problems. Her experience includes 2 years' work with the Applied Research Laboratories at University of Texas Austin, where she developed software for real-time monitoring of GPS signals. Weber's skill set includes modern toolsets in high performance computing, machine learning, computer graphics, application development, and web development. She graduated from the University of North Carolina at Charlotte in June 2021 with an MS in Computer Science, where her strong interest in high performance computing and computer architecture led her to seek a research position under Dr. Erik Saule. Weber values compassion, critical thinking, honesty, and clear expectations in a work environment. She are currently seeking employment with a company that can utilize her passion for fault tolerant and performant computing.
